mission: Deliver Effect-native observable capability parity with pinned official eyecite 2.7.6, exact verified source evidence, schema-first legal models, lawful transformations, and proven TypeScript-port extensions.
statusNote: P0/P1 remain in progress. The existing Citation union contains only eight canonical semantic families after retirement of 37 provisional mixed/locator/relationship/extension directories. Shared persisted citation identity is distinct; SourceRef quote-selector encoding is preserved. No donor disposition or behavior parity is completed by removing obsolete APIs/tests. Verified mention composition and explicit receipt restoration pass local package gates; they do not attest semantic classification. Private ca1 production matches focused oracle equality and protocol vectors; artifact integration and full grouping remain open. Stable-ID document/resolution schemas validate graph coherence and structural receipt round-trips. Authority representatives now permit any resolved mention; private persistence now accepts exact out-of-band canonical/external resource bindings and rejects unverified custom keys. A private callback session now executes all five captured callbacks and matches 18 focused source contexts / 53 events through test adapters; production defaults now pass all 76 default contexts through that session and also serve the 18 custom traces. Work accounting is shared and operation-local. General host/alias/model mutation and final document/service integration remain open. Private document projection/restoration validates occurrence/default authority keys and shares source verification. Private resolver text helpers preserve frozen Unicode/punctuation and arbitrary-precision Id. pin behavior. The private default resolver matches 46 focused scenes and all 30 committed default resolution calls over all canonical families, totaling 76 semantic contexts and 210 mentions; original-source span/extraction proof stays separate. Exhaustive resolver/custom-resource proof, live artifact integration, Bluebook codecs, extension proof and the bounded parser remain unfinished. Sixteen additional callback mutation scenes expose empty/ordered/repeated/cross-group values and alias/detached requirements. Ten final group-value cases match the private session; all identity-slot and six alias/detached target proofs remain open.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until the packet rebaseline, implementation, corpus, transforms, proof, reflection, and lifecycle update ship in one PR driven to mergeable through bun run beep yeet repair, verify, publish --message, and monitor.

phases.name: Source baseline and exhaustive capability accounting
Differential, span, transform, regex, and repo verification
Close one Yeet PR to mergeable

verificationCommands: git diff --check origin/main...HEAD -- goals/citation-extraction-engine goals/INDEX.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
stopConditions: Either prerequisite contract is absent, incompatible, or accessible only through raw generated files.
The pinned canonical oracle cannot be executed, licensed, normalized, or accounted for case by case.
Parity would require a second public citation hierarchy, hosted truth, weakened exact-source fidelity, or unbounded execution.
A claimed reversible transform would need to invent missing information.
Verification requires unnamed credentials, unauthorized cost, destructive side effects, or broader product authority.
